schema.title: TestEmailRequest
schema.description:
Request body for POST /api/settings/notifications/test-email.

The ``smtp_*`` fields are all optional and, when present, override the
persisted SMTP config for this test send only — they let the Notifications
tab test the form's current (possibly unsaved) values instead of requiring
Save first. Omit them (or omit the whole set) to test the saved config.
